item.ingredientpouchdsc: A Cloth bag with spice vials tied to it, specially crafted to hold ingredients for cooking. Has a strap for carrying over your shoulder.
item.jamjardsc: A transparent jar made for holding various jams. Your captors spoke about bringing these to picnics.
item.spoondsc: A metallic spoon made for taking smaller portions out of food, and sometimes medicine. This one holds 15 Ml of liquid.
item.yogurtcupdsc: A small cup containing yogurt. Eating from it is a little messy.
item.yogurtbottledsc: A big plastic bottle with a cutesy pink hue. Contains unflavoured yogurt.
item.icecreamtubdsc: A family-sized tub with a faded label, containing a huge portion of Ice-cream. Better be careful with brainfreeze!
item.oliveoilbottledsc: A tall bottle filled with extra virgin olive oil. You find the shape of the glass kinda funny.
item.immersionheaterdsc: A small hand-held heating element, powered by a small battery. Pretty efficient, and could be used for cooking!
item.geojamdsc: A blue-hued jam made from geofruit. Basic, accessible, but not very filling.
item.stonefruitjamdsc: A neutral-tasting, coarse spread with a green hue. Made with opened stonefruits. Due to it being a dry fruit, it'll need some water to soften up into jam.
item.cactusjamdsc: A sweet jam made from cactus flesh, with all of its prickly spines removed. Watery, but yummy!
item.poppingjamdsc: A bright green jam that passively crackles. It emits a soft glow once disturbed... Its radiation reducing or boosting effects are enhanced. Still tasty, though!
item.bananamashdsc: Bananas mashed together into what roughly resembles a watery jam. It tastes really nice now without the peel, but is slightly more radioactive.
item.numbingjamdsc: A creamy, airy jam made from numberries. While it tastes disgusting, it can be applied directly to the skin to soothe aches. Lesser effect when eaten.
item.suspiciousjamdsc: A sticky, brown jam made with miscellaneous mushrooms smashed together. You don't know what it does, but at least it's edible?
item.sausagedsc: A standard sausage made by stuffing intestines with meat. A bit bland, but still filling.
item.bloodsausagedsc: A dark sausage made by filling empty intestines with meat and blood, cooked over oil. Sickening in excess, but really fatty and filling.
item.kebabdsc: Whatever meats you could find, pierced through a wooden stick and cooked. Lightweight, easy to carry around.
item.beefjerkydsc: Sliced cuts of dried meat, dehydrated over low heat and wrapped in a canvas. Not very flavorful, but effectively never spoils.
item.mincedmeatdsc: Ground up meat mixed with fat, all the unusable parts being removed before grinding. A really good way to re-use meat!
item.roseskindsc: The dark outer layer of a Roselight. The foliage is quite resistent, and it still has a slight glow to it.
item.toastdsc: Bread, sliced and toasted. A little dry, and not too nutritious. Would go well with some jam or butter!
item.geojamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one feels classic by this point.
item.stonefruitjamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one makes your throat dry.
item.cactusjamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one is specially watery!
item.poppingjamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one crackles with every bite!
item.bananamashtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one could go well with some spice.
item.numbingjamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one makes your tongue tingle.
item.suspiciousjamtoastdsc: Some toast with jam spread onto it. Could be a staple in a picnic, if it weren't for your situation. This one tastes funny!
item.doughdsc: Simple dough made from flour and water, useable in many recipes!
item.rawsugardsc: Unrefined sugar made from the caramelization and crushing of sugary products. Sickening to eat on its own, but could be used for other recipes.
item.refinedsugardsc: Bright white, processed sugar. Somehow feels even sweeter than raw sugar. Much more efficient in recipes than its less processed counterpart.
item.tanghuludsc: Whatever fruits you could find, covered in caramel, pierced through a stick to prevent messes. A quick snack, but slightly fatty.
item.bananasplitdsc: Three dollops of ice-cream served with two bananas and a chocolate sauce drizzled all over. You feel on the top of the world eating this, nevermind the radiation! Filling, fatty, and delicious.
item.donutdsc: A crispy pastry made from rolled up dough, with a chocolatey glaze on top. Fatty and sickening, but you feel satisfied eating it.

other.lattedsc: Sweet beverage made from coffee, warm milk, and a little bit of sugar. Not as stimulating as pure coffee, but definitely sweeter and less toxic.
other.meatsaucedsc: A deep red condiment made by crushing, rendering, and filtering blobflesh. It doesn't taste good on its own, but can be used as a condiment for various dishes.
other.helluceteadsc: A Spicy medicinal tea made with helluce. All of its healing capabilities seem to be boosted. Its heating hability has severely dampened, as they have been used up to heat the tea's water.
other.popteadsc: A slightly gooey, disgusting-looking tea made with popskin. Drinking it gives you a pang of adrenaline, and on top of that, it's actually pretty analgesic! It does make you feel woozy, though. Can be soaked on a limb for pain relief.
other.roseteadsc: A pale pink tea made with the skin of a Rose Pod. It tastes horrible, and doesn't sit well on your stomach. When ingested, it reacts with stomach acid and makes you glow for a while. Somewhat antibiotic.
other.chocolatesaucedsc: A condiment made with chocolate, used to be drizzled on top of pastries, ice-cream, and various other desserts. Yummy on its own, but your stomach won't like it.
